name: Breaststroke (Long Box)
summary: Face down on the long box, reach the arms forward and circle them back while extending the spine.
steps: Long box over the shoulder rests. Lie face down facing the footbar, chest at the front edge, straps in the hands by the shoulders.
Breathe out to reach the arms straight ahead; the carriage moves back.
Lift the chest and sweep the arms wide and round to the hips.
Breathe in to lengthen, bend the elbows and return to the start.
modifications: Bend the knees for a tender lower back.
Light springs, or no straps, for sore shoulders.
cues:
Pelvis and thighs stay heavy.
Upper arms by the ears on the reach.
Head stays down until the arms begin to circle.
Legs long and awake.
